notes.t: Called Ben the winner; says Ben took advantage of Alex's thin, injured bench and Alex could have covered with a free agent. Likes Golden but thinks Stevenson is pointless.
Tuten has good advanced stats, Golden passes the eye test, and Stevenson will keep a role.
Likes Golden (about 10 targets a game) and Tuten (clear lead back, few targets); sees it as roughly fair once Stevenson is included.
Said Joe got fleeced and would have landed a fair deal by waiting about six hours.
Pushed back: he had another deal in the works and the player would not have been on his team six hours later.
Quipped that sometimes you have to go backwards to go backwards, a mild dig at Joe's side.
Joked that sometimes you have to go back to go forward, posting a couple of memes.
Prefers Aidan's side and calls him the real winner for the roster spots freed up.
Sees it as roughly equal draft dollars swapped.
Thinks Joe got the better end but it is close and fair either way.
Says the deal was straightforward: he made the offer and it was accepted.
